text:
Power Stations | Technical Procedure
Introduction
This document outlines the 
equipment inspection I1, which must be performed every three months as indicated 
by M3 in the title block.
The first initiated by eng. Mohamed 
Mostafa El-Zalabany, tested by eng. Samir Ouf Hassoub, accepted by 
general manager eng. Hamdy Dorgam, 
approved by eng. Gaber Mohamed Farahat head sector 
of Damanhour power station, and 
certified by eng. Sania 
Diab Attia Diab WDEPC Inspection head sector and MPIS coordinator.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry the suitable 
safety category
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is required
Wear the appropriate safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, helmet ... 
etc
